annotations.title: Suburb · Crime by time of day (Queensland)

description:
When police-recorded offences happen in Queensland suburbs: counts and shares by 3-hour band and by day of week, over the last 12 months.

Coverage: Queensland: 2,584 suburbs with offences; 12 months to 2026-11-04. Current to 2026-11-04. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/crime-time-of-day-qld`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**
